title: Rising Costs Test Republicans Before Midterms
description:
Affordability is emerging as a central midterm issue as Americans contend with higher energy and everyday costs, putting pressure on Republicans to show how they would deliver relief. Bloomberg Opinion Senior Executive Editor Tim O’Brien and Bloomberg News Texas Bureau Chief Julie Fine join Bloomberg This Weekend and discuss Trump’s proposed $5,000 dividend, growing resistance to the costs of Texas data centers and how economic concerns are shaping the political debate heading into November.
